basis: Q3 non-GAAP EPS of $1.11 beat the company's own $0.88-0.93 range by about 22%, on record revenue up 34% and non-GAAP gross margin up 350bp sequentially. The company raised FY26 EPS and FCF, raised the FY27 framework (revenue +13-17%, EPS +16-20%, FCF of at least $5bn), guided Q4 EPS to $1.20-1.30 and cited a record backlog. A beat and raise this large is outsized for a mega-cap.
